driver_source:
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
candidate = json.loads((root/'artifacts/control-frame-candidate.json').read_text())
servers = {'before':root/'artifacts/baselines/routing-owner-candidate/war-relay',
           'selected':root/candidate['directory']/'war-relay'}
client = root/'artifacts/baselines/paging-candidate/inspection'
output = root/'docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-control-frame-cbor-confirmation.json'
record = {'scope':'30 sequential fresh processes; three repetitions rotate workload order and reverse implementation order. Four server workers on CPUs0-3, one frozen client on CPUs4-7. Eight-second cases hold8192 idle rooms and one private pair, 1KiB values/window16. Private has no churn/inspection. Churn adds eight reconnect workers. Full adds200 complete HTTP listings/s; cbor adds200 complete authenticated CBOR channel queries/s; page100 requests200 first100-row pages/s and verifies full traversals at quiescent gates. Equivalent outputs within each workload; full body/sender/FIFO/field/order/cursor/Close/EOF/exact counter/resource checks. No builds, profilers or competing load tests overlap ordinary timing.',
          'before_runtime_revision':'1d766c279e19d567d9dba49d276c1541cbe173d6',
          'selected_source_hashes':candidate['sources'],
          'variants':{k:{'path':str(p.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(p)} for k,p in servers.items()},
          'client':{'path':str(client.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(client),
                    'source_path':str((client.parent/'inspection.rs').relative_to(root)),
                    'source_sha256':sha(client.parent/'inspection.rs'),
                    'runtime_revision':'2e7806b8e255527cc0dc3cc6ffc6813859f71426'},
          'helpers':{name:sha(root/'scripts'/name) for name in ['inspection.py','benchmark.py']},
          'driver_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'driver_sha256':sha(__file__),'cases':[],'passed':False}
workloads = ['cbor']
initial_path = root/'docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-control-frame-comparison.json'
initial = json.loads(initial_path.read_text())
assert initial['passed'] and len(initial['cases']) == 30
record['scope'] = 'Fixed six-pair extension of the CBOR inspection workload after the initial three pairs had overlapping ranges and a lower selected median. All six initial CBOR cases retained; twelve fresh cases added. Same frozen client/server binaries,8192 rooms,one private pair,1KiB/window16,eight reconnect workers,200 complete CBOR inspections/s,eight seconds per case. Server CPUs0-3/client4-7. All payload/order/field/Close/EOF/exact counter/resource checks; no builds, profiling or competing load tests overlap.'
record['cases'] = [row for row in initial['cases'] if row['workload']=='cbor']
assert len(record['cases']) == 6
record['initial_comparison'] = {'path':str(initial_path.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(initial_path)}
record['fixed_additional_pairs'] = 6
for repetition in range(4,10):
    offset = (repetition-1)%len(workloads)
    for workload in workloads[offset:]+workloads[:offset]:
        roles = ['before','selected'] if repetition%2 else ['selected','before']
        for role in roles:
            trace = output.with_name(f'{output.stem}-{workload}-{role}-{repetition}.json')
            command = [sys.executable,str(root/'scripts/inspection.py'),'--server',str(servers[role]),
                       '--client',str(client),'--pairs','1','--seconds','8',
                       '--mode',('cbor' if workload=='cbor' else 'http' if workload in ['full','page100'] else 'none'),
                       '--churn-workers','0' if workload=='private' else '8','--output',str(trace)]
            if workload=='page100': command += ['--page-size','100']
            done = subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
            data = json.loads(trace.read_text())
            assert done.returncode == 0 and data['passed'],done.stdout+done.stderr
            assert not data['profile_diagnostic'] and data['server_sha256']==record['variants'][role]['sha256']
            assert data['client_sha256']==record['client']['sha256']
            assert data['client_source_sha256']==record['client']['source_sha256']
            mixed = data['mixed']
            row = {'kind':role,'workload':workload,'repetition':repetition,
                   'trace':str(trace.relative_to(root)),'trace_sha256':sha(trace),'passed':True,
                   'healthy':mixed['healthy']['per_second'],'healthy_p99_ms':mixed['healthy']['p99_upper_ms'],
                   'churn':mixed['churn']['per_second'],'churn_p99_ms':mixed['churn']['p99_upper_ms'],
                   'inspection':mixed['inspection']['per_second'],'inspection_p99_ms':mixed['inspection']['p99_upper_ms'],
                   'cpu_wall':mixed['server_cpu_seconds_per_wall_second'],'rss_mib':data['events'][1]['process']['VmRSS']/1024}
            record['cases'].append(row); output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
            print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
record['medians'] = {}
for workload in workloads:
    for role in servers:
        rows = [r for r in record['cases'] if r['kind']==role and r['workload']==workload]
        fields = ['healthy','healthy_p99_ms','churn','churn_p99_ms','inspection','inspection_p99_ms','cpu_wall','rss_mib']
        summary = {key:statistics.median(r[key] for r in rows) for key in fields}
        summary['ranges'] = {key:[min(r[key] for r in rows),max(r[key] for r in rows)] for key in ['healthy','churn','cpu_wall']}
        record['medians'][workload+'/'+role] = summary
record['passed'] = True; output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record['medians']),flush=True)
